title: Levenda as the model for Johnny Depp's character in The Ninth Gate

tellings.quote: people around Depp were saying this actually happened.

plain: The character Johnny Depp played in The Ninth Gate, a film by Roman Polanski about the hunt for an occult book, was modelled on the author Peter Levenda. Levenda tells this about himself, passing on that "people around Depp were saying this actually happened." He links it to his own years in New York's occult book world.
